plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the nineteenth season of , Pokémon the Series: XYZ, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Two Pokémon the Series: XYZ DVD sets were released between 2017 and 2018 by VIZ Media and distributed through , containing the whole season between them. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

===Set 1===
 
Pokémon the Series: XYZ, Set 1 was released on August 29, 2017. It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined.

 

===Set 2===
 
Pokémon the Series: XYZ, Set 2 was released on February 6, 2018. It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined.

 

== The Complete Season ==
 
Pokémon The Series: XYZ - The Complete Season was released by with distribution through on February 11, 2025. This Complete Collection set contains 6 DVD discs with forty-eight episodes altogether, in a with stereo audio and optional English SDH subtitles.
